14. Subject  to  the  provisions  of  this  Act,  the  body
corporate shall be able and capable in law, to take and hold
any  property  movable  or  immovable  which  may  become
vested  in  it  by  virtue  of  any  purchase  grant,  gift,
testamentary  disposition  or  otherwise,  and  all  such
property shall be held by the body corporate for the purposes
of this Act, and subject to the rules of the body corporate
